task: Gate 4 re-validation (fresh name, never used in any battery) — Aarti Industries / NSE AARTIIND
summary: D66 quarterly-YoY growth cross-check behaved exactly as designed for AARTIIND: provider scalars (revenue_growth 13.2%, earnings_growth 43.4%) and the app's own quarterly-statement-derived figures (revenue_growth_computed 13.13%, earnings_growth_computed 42.71%) both land inside the documented tolerance band (max(10% relative, 2pp absolute)), so the derived leg correctly emits conflicts: []. Both the provider figures AND the computed figures independently agree with my web-sourced ground truth (screener.in quarterly table + press coverage of the Q4 FY26 result): revenue +13.1-13.2% YoY, net profit +42.7% YoY, same Mar-2026-vs-Mar-2025 quarter pair the app names in growth_computed_quarters. Identity, price, market cap and PE all reconcile within tolerance. One architectural note (not a defect): GET /fundamentals/{symbol} alone never populates the *_computed fields or growth_computed_quarters — those are only attached inside the research-invoke snapshot path (services/research/fast.py -> semantics.py); this matches the code as designed, and the task's own two-step protocol (fundamentals GET, then research invoke) accounts for it.
